title: Numbers to 1 000: Counting, Names and Comparing
seo_title: Grade 3 Numbers to 1 000 Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade 3: Count forwards and backwards; number symbols and names
standard_text: Count forwards and backwards in 1s, 2s, 3s, 4s, 5s, 10s, 25s, 50s and 100s between 0 and at least 1 000; know number names and symbols to 1 000; describe, compare and order numbers to 999.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 3 maths worksheets: counting to 1 000, number lines, number names, comparing and ordering numbers. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Count in 1s, 2s, 5s, 10s, 50s and 100s by adding the same step each time.
  • After 499 comes 500; after 990 (in 10s) comes 1 000.
  • To compare, look at the hundreds first, then the tens, then the ones.
  • Read 305 as three hundred and five.

Examples

Example

Count on in 100s: 250, 350, …

add 100

Answer: 450

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
At a new hundredAfter 299 comes 300.
Ones firstCompare the hundreds first.
Zeros305 has no tens.
